sentences.english: I'll be there in fifteen minutes.
sentences.chinese: 我十五分钟后到。

sentences.english: My little sister just turned fifteen, and we threw her a surprise party with all her friends.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹刚满十五岁，我们给她办了一个惊喜派对，请了她所有的朋友。

sentences.english: When I was fifteen, I thought I knew everything about the world, but looking back now, I realize I was just a kid who had barely scratched the surface of anything.
sentences.chinese: 我十五岁的时候，以为自己对世界无所不知，但现在回头看，才意识到自己不过是个对什么都一知半解的孩子罢了。

sentences.english: My son is twelve years old.
sentences.chinese: 我儿子十二岁了。

sentences.english: We need at least twelve cupcakes for the class party, but I bought fifteen just in case.
sentences.chinese: 班级派对至少需要十二个纸杯蛋糕，但我买了十五个以防万一。

sentences.english: I remember when I was twelve, my biggest worry was whether I'd get picked for the school soccer team, and I'd give anything to have such simple problems again.
sentences.chinese: 记得十二岁时，我最大的烦恼就是能不能入选校足球队，我真希望能再次拥有那样简单的问题。

sentences.english: She is fourteen years old.
sentences.chinese: 她十四岁了。

sentences.english: I babysat my neighbor's fourteen-year-old twins last night, and they taught me how to play their favorite video game.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚我帮邻居照看他们十四岁的双胞胎，他们教了我玩他们最喜欢的电子游戏。

sentences.english: At fourteen, I was so impatient to grow up, but now I'd happily trade places with my teenage self for just one weekend to have zero responsibilities again.
sentences.chinese: 十四岁时，我迫不及待想长大，但现在我宁愿用一天周末换回少年时代的无忧无虑。

sentences.english: I counted thirteen birds outside.
sentences.chinese: 我数到外面有十三只鸟。

sentences.english: There were thirteen people at the dinner table, so we had to squeeze in an extra chair.
sentences.chinese: 餐桌旁坐了十三个人，我们只好硬挤进一把额外的椅子。

sentences.english: I'm not superstitious, but when the elevator stopped on the thirteenth floor and the lights flickered, I'll admit I held my breath for a second.
sentences.chinese: 我并不迷信，但当电梯停在十三楼，灯光闪了一下时，我承认我屏住呼吸了一秒钟。

sentences.english: The meeting starts at eleven.
sentences.chinese: 会议十一点开始。

sentences.english: I set my alarm for seven, but somehow slept until eleven and missed my morning class completely.
sentences.chinese: 我设了七点的闹钟，但不知怎的一觉睡到十一点，完全错过了上午的课。

sentences.english: By eleven o'clock last night, I had finished all my homework and was about to go to bed when my friend called and we ended up talking for another two hours.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚十一点前，我做完了所有作业，正准备上床睡觉，朋友突然打来电话，我们最后又聊了两个小时。

sentences.english: I only have twenty dollars left.
sentences.chinese: 我只剩二十美元了。

sentences.english: There are about twenty people ahead of us in line, so we'll probably be waiting for a while.
sentences.chinese: 我们前面大概有二十个人在排队，所以可能得等一会儿。

sentences.english: I remember my twentieth birthday clearly — I was in college, my roommates surprised me with a homemade cake, and we stayed up until three in the morning just laughing and telling stories.
sentences.chinese: 我清楚记得我的二十岁生日——当时我上大学，室友们用自制蛋糕给了我一个惊喜，我们说说笑笑一直熬到凌晨三点。

sentences.english: He's seventeen and learning to drive.
sentences.chinese: 他十七岁，正在学开车。

sentences.english: When I was seventeen, I got my first summer job scooping ice cream at a shop near the beach.
sentences.chinese: 我十七岁时，得到了第一份暑期工作，在海滩附近的一家冰淇淋店挖冰淇淋。

sentences.english: Being seventeen felt like being stuck between a kid and an adult — one day I was stressing about math tests, the next I was having deep conversations about life with my friends until midnight.
sentences.chinese: 十七岁感觉就像是卡在小孩和成人之间——今天还在为数学考试焦虑，明天就和朋友们进行关于人生的深夜长谈。

sentences.english: She got a car at sixteen.
sentences.chinese: 她十六岁时得到了一辆车。

sentences.english: I can't believe my daughter is sixteen already; it feels like she started kindergarten just yesterday.
sentences.chinese: 真不敢相信我女儿已经十六岁了，感觉她昨天才刚上幼儿园。

sentences.english: Turning sixteen felt like such a huge deal back then — I finally felt like I had some freedom, even if it just meant I could go to the mall without my mom dropping me off.
sentences.chinese: 当年满十六岁可是件天大的事——我终于觉得自己有了一点自由，哪怕只是不用妈妈开车送我去购物中心。

sentences.english: I moved out at eighteen.
sentences.chinese: 我十八岁就搬出去住了。

sentences.english: The night before my eighteenth birthday, I couldn't sleep because I was so excited about finally being an adult.
sentences.chinese: 十八岁生日前一晚，我兴奋得睡不着，因为终于要成年了。

sentences.english: At eighteen, I thought I had my whole life figured out, but the truth is, I had no idea who I really was or what I wanted, and that's perfectly okay.
sentences.chinese: 十八岁时，我以为自己已经规划好了整个人生，但事实是，我根本不知道自己是谁、想要什么，而这完全没问题。

sentences.english: I was nineteen when we met.
sentences.chinese: 我们认识时我十九岁。

sentences.english: Nineteen is a weird age because you're not a teenager anymore, but you still don't feel like a real adult.
sentences.chinese: 十九岁是个奇怪的年龄，因为不再是青少年了，但还是不觉得自己是真正的成年人。

sentences.english: The summer I was nineteen, I took a road trip with my two best friends, and we slept in the car, got lost multiple times, and made memories I still treasure to this day.
sentences.chinese: 我十九岁那年的夏天，和两个最好的朋友进行了一次公路旅行，我们睡在车里，迷路了好几次，创造了我至今仍然珍藏的回忆。

sentences.english: My son loves his piggy bank.
sentences.chinese: 我儿子很喜欢他的存钱罐。

sentences.english: I dropped all my spare change into my piggy bank for a year, and it added up to almost two hundred dollars.
sentences.chinese: 我把所有零钱都扔进存钱罐攒了一年，加起来差不多有二百美元。

sentences.english: I still have the piggy bank my grandmother gave me when I was five — it's a little ceramic pig with a chipped ear, but every time I see it on my shelf, it reminds me of her teaching me to save money for something special.
sentences.chinese: 我还留着我五岁时奶奶给我的存钱罐——那是一只缺了耳朵的小瓷猪，但每次在架子上看到它，就想起她教我为了特别的东西存钱的情景。

sentences.english: I'll pay for lunch.
sentences.chinese: 午饭我来付钱。

sentences.english: I need to pay my phone bill by Friday, or they'll cut off my service.
sentences.chinese: 我必须在周五前交电话费，否则他们就会停机。

sentences.english: I was about to pay for my groceries when I realized I'd left my wallet at home, and I had to step aside while the cashier gave me that look and put my items to the side.
sentences.chinese: 我正准备付杂货钱时，突然发现把钱包忘在家里了，只好退到一边，收银员用那种眼神看着我，把我的东西放到了一旁。

sentences.english: Call me back later.
sentences.chinese: 稍后给我回电话。

sentences.english: I can't wait to get back home and sleep in my own bed after this long trip.
sentences.chinese: 这次长途旅行之后，我迫不及待想回到家，睡在我自己的床上。

sentences.english: I pulled my back while trying to move the couch by myself, and now every time I bend over, there's this sharp pain that reminds me I should have asked for help.
sentences.chinese: 我一个人搬沙发时扭伤了背，现在每次弯腰都会一阵剧痛，提醒我本该叫人帮忙的。
